subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Load Testing
description: A fast breakdown of Load Testing for builders.

hook.text: An airline website handles bookings fine on quiet days. On sale day, it crumbles. Nobody tested the spike.

buildup.text: Load testing simulates expected user traffic to see if the system meets performance targets.

discovery.text: It reveals how response times, throughput, and error rates change as concurrent users increase.

twist.text: The goal isn't to break the system. It's to confirm it works well under normal peak conditions.

climax.text: The airline load-tests with 10,000 simulated users. They find and fix three bottlenecks before sale day.

punchline.text: Load testing answers: can we handle the traffic we expect?
